query:
UPDATE event.programme_tracks SET
               code         = $2,
               slug         = $3::text::platform.slug,
               kind         = $4::text::event.track_kind,
               title        = $5::jsonb,
               subtitle     = $6::jsonb,
               description  = $7::jsonb,
               starts_on    = $8,
               ends_on      = $9,
               color_hex    = $10,
               curated_by   = $11,
               published_at = CASE WHEN $12 THEN COALESCE(published_at, now()) END,
               sort_order   = $13
         WHERE id = $1
